summary: Added an executionStartPersisted guard in src/commands/goal-resume.ts so persistRun() only honors on-disk cancelled state after the first successful executing-state persist. This preserves intentional resume startup writes while preventing later task-update persists from overwriting external /goal_stop cancellation. Verified with pnpm build and pnpm vitest run src/commands/goal-resume.test.ts (39/39 passing).
